concerns.text: FR-001 (US-1) requires extracting BOLD timecourses for Left Hippocampus, Right Hippocampus, and DLPFC. Tasks T014, T015, and T016 are marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`) and lack implementation details (e.g., specific nilearn functions, subject iteration logic). Without these tasks being actionable, the FR-001 requirement for data extraction cannot be satisfied.

FR-001 (US-1) requires downloading ROCStories and formatting for analysis. Tasks T019 (download), T019a (boundary extraction), T021a (event averaging), and T021b (finalizing CSV) are marked incomplete. T019 references a specific HuggingFace ID ('jamestran/roc_stories') which may not exist or be the canonical source; T021a depends on T019a which is unimplemented. The pipeline cannot produce the required `event_averages.csv` artifact.

FR-002, FR-003, and FR-004 (US-2) require implementing the SAE, Gating Module, and generating 1,000+ stories. Tasks T029a (training loop), T030 (Brain-Inspired generation), and T031 (Baseline generation) are marked incomplete. T029a relies on a '[deferred]' validation split definition which is not resolved in the task description, making the retry logic untestable. T030 and T031 depend on T029a completion.

FR-005, FR-006, and FR-007 (US-3) require RSA computation, permutation testing, and visualization. Tasks T036 (RSA matrix), T037 (permutation test), T038 (validation), T039 (heatmap), and T040 (bar plot) are all marked incomplete. T036 depends on T030/T031 (model outputs) and T017c/T021b (data outputs), all of which are currently unimplemented/incomplete. The validation layer cannot be executed.

Tasks T045-T048 implement 'narrative uncertainty', 'variations', 'DG/CA3 substructure', and 'consolidation'. While these address reviewer feedback, the spec.md (FR-001 to FR-007) and Success Criteria (SC-001 to SC-005) do not contain requirements for these specific features. There is no task mapping to a spec requirement for these items, creating a gap where the tasks exist but the spec requirement they satisfy is missing (or they are scope creep without a requirement anchor).

Tasks T014, T015, and T016 contain a copy-paste error in their descriptions: 'The research question, method, and references remain unchanged...' text is pasted into the task description for T015 and T016, obscuring the actual task instructions. This is a writing defect that needs correction to ensure the task is clear.
